data.case_title: Accident insurance recognizes son's school-commute accident as a work accident
data.title: Accident insurance recognizes son's school-commute accident as a work accident (Unfallkasse Beispiel-Mitte)
data.summary: Unfallkasse Beispiel-Mitte informs Johanna Beispielacker that her son Paul's bicycle fall on the direct way to school on 14 September 2026 is recognized as a work accident (Arbeitsunfall) under § 8 Abs. 2 SGB VII, and that it will cover the costs of medical treatment and physiotherapy. Doctors and therapists bill the insurer directly, so she should not submit receipts herself.
data.explanation: This is a favorable decision: the statutory accident insurance (Unfallkasse) has accepted your son's fall on his school commute as an insured work accident and will pay for his medical treatment and physiotherapy directly with the practices, so you do not need to submit any bills yourself. If you disagree with any part of the decision, you have the right to file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing; the app shows the deadline for this. If you take no action, the decision simply stands and the Unfallkasse continues covering the treatment costs as described.
